results.title: Long Product Sync (2.5 mins)
results.hyp_transcript: Haan toh basically kal ka jo project sync tha usmein humne thoda sa discuss kiya ki app ka current status kya hai aur next week tak humein exactly kya complete karna hai. Abhi back end ka major part almost done hai. But transcription pipeline mein thoda latency issue aa raha hai. Kabhi kabhi audio upload karne ke baad transcript aane mein 30-40 seconds lag rahe hain. which is okay for a prototype but production mein itna delay nahi hona chahiye. Rohit ne bola ki woh aaj evening tak check karega ki processing ko background job mein shift kar sakte hain ya nahi. Agar woh possible hai toh user ko ek loading state dikha denge instead of making them wait on the same screen. Maine bola ki haan ye better approach hai. Front End Site pe Neha ko Summary aur Action Items ka UI Finalize karna hai. Abhi Cards thode Basic hain toh Ideally Summary ek Separate Section mein ho aur Action Items Checkbox ke saath dikhen. Important ye hai ki agar Action Item mein Deadline ya kisi person ka naam Mention ho toh woh bhi Extract ho jaaye. For example Friday client email output owner amit task client email due date Friday. Ek aur cheez. Humein English ke liye testing aur karni padegi because kuch recordings mein English aur Hindi. Sentence ke beech mein switching kaafi frequent hai. Maine do sample recordings already share kar di hain. But Priya ko aur at least 5 recordings collect karke deni hai preferably different accents or different speaking speeds ke saath. Marketing wala part abhi hold pe rakho because product flow stable hone ke baad high landing page copy finalize karna useful hoga. So immediate priority back-end latency, action item extraction aur front-end UI hai. Aaj ke end tak Rohit latency ka update dega, Neha latest UI screenshots share karegi aur Priya testing ke liye additional recordings upload karegi. Main meanwhile extraction prompt ko improve karunga aur specifically dates, names aur tasks ko structured format mein nikalne ki koshish karunga. Aur haan kal subah 11 baje ek short 15 minute sync rakh lete hain usmein bas blockers discuss karenge koi long meeting nahi. Agar sab green hai toh directly implementation continue karenge.
results.summary: The team reviewed the app's current status and next week's objectives, noting that the backend is largely complete but the transcription pipeline has latency issues. Immediate priorities include resolving backend latency, enhancing action item extraction, and finalizing the front-end UI for summaries and action items. A brief 15-minute sync is scheduled for tomorrow at 11 AM to discuss any blockers.
action_items: Rohit to check if transcription processing can be shifted to a background job by evening and provide an update.
Neha to finalize the Summary and Action Items UI, ensuring summaries are in a separate section and action items have checkboxes.
Priya to collect at least 5 additional English recordings with different accents/speeds for testing.
Improve the extraction prompt to specifically extract dates, names, and tasks in a structured format.
Hold a 15-minute sync meeting tomorrow at 11 AM to discuss blockers.

results.title: Urgent Production Bug Triage
results.hyp_transcript: Production Database pe Timeout Errors aa rahe hain. Amit, Do Please Logs check kar aur Replica Node ko Restart kar. Agar 15 minute mein Fix nahi hua toh main Team ko Alert karunga.
results.summary: The production database is encountering timeout errors. Amit has been instructed to investigate the logs and restart the replica node. If the problem persists beyond 15 minutes, the team will be notified.
action_items: Amit to check logs for production database timeout errors.
Amit to restart the replica node.
Alert the team if the issue is not resolved within 15 minutes.
